summary: swing_double / airport concourse double egress: mechanism_cannot_work; wrong_scale

findings.description: The caption states 2 leaves of 0.914 x 2.134 x 0.044 m in hollow_metal_18ga and a total of 62.9 kg. The stated area density is 24.2 kg/m2, so those leaves weigh 95 kg between them: the slab mass has been computed for one leaf and then split across all 2. Every leaf is 2x too light.
findings.where: caption; the leaves in panels 1 and 2

findings.description: The caption calls this a double-egress pair, which by definition has one leaf swinging each way. Both leaves are hinged on the same axis sign with the same range, so both swing the same way: it is an ordinary pair.
